title: Website QA Report - Just Like Home Daycare

findings.title: Multiple internal links return 404 on live site
findings.description: Automated crawl found three internal destinations returning 404: /programs/toddler-care/, /resources/choosing-a-daycare-in-lakewood-wa/, and /about-us/testimonials/. These links are present in live location pages and break navigation paths for users.
findings.suggested_fix: Update link targets to existing routes or add redirects for legacy paths.

findings.title: In-page anchor target missing on careers page
findings.description: The CTA link uses #apply-form but no matching element id exists on the page, so the button does not jump to the intended form section.
findings.suggested_fix: Change CTA href to #apply or add id=apply-form to the form section.

findings.title: Legacy routes are not redirected
findings.description: No redirect rules were found in src/_redirects or public/_redirects, and legacy paths like /schedule-tour/ return 404 directly. This can break historical links and search index continuity.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit redirects for known historical routes in _redirects.
findings.screenshot_na: HTTP status checks for legacy paths

findings.title: Open Graph canonical and image URLs point to a parked domain
findings.description: OG tags use justlikehomecenter.com URLs. That domain currently redirects to a parked page, and the OG image URL resolves to 404 on the redirected host. Social shares are likely to show incorrect or missing previews.
findings.suggested_fix: Point OG URL and OG image to a live canonical domain and verify 200 responses.

findings.title: Twitter/X meta tags missing across all pages
findings.description: twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, and twitter:image are not present. This weakens social snippet quality on platforms that still consume Twitter metadata.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Twitter meta tags in the shared head template with page-specific values.

findings.title: HTML validation errors in careers and contact pages
findings.description: Validator reports a stray closing div in careers output and an invalid aria-label on a generic div in contact output. These indicate markup quality issues that may affect semantics and maintainability.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the extra closing div in careers template and add role=group (or remove aria-label) for the contact main-line div.

findings.title: Privacy Policy and Terms pages are emitted as invalid full documents
findings.description: Validator reports missing DOCTYPE, missing title, and missing language metadata. Current templates define head/body blocks but do not extend the base layout, so output is not a complete HTML document.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the base layout for both legal pages or provide complete valid HTML wrappers.

findings.title: Embedded lead forms show load failures in automated browser context
findings.description: Third-party requests for lead connector/recaptcha intermittently abort in automation, and pages can remain in loading-form state. This may be bot-protection related, but it impacts form availability during QA.
findings.suggested_fix: Manually verify form loading on Chrome, Safari iOS, and Firefox; add fallback contact path when embed fails.

findings.title: PageSpeed API blocked by quota in current environment
findings.description: Google PageSpeed API returned 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for both Netlify and canonical domain tests, so category scoring could not be produced in this run.
findings.suggested_fix: Run PageSpeed with a project API key or run Lighthouse CLI outside the blocked quota context.
